name: Frozen Chocolate, Peanut Butter & Banana "Bark" (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!

Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper. Peel bananas, cut in half lengthwise, and arrange on the baking sheet. Cover with a second sheet of parchment, then use the bottom of a jar or measuring cup to squish the bananas until they are flat. Use a spoon, if necessary, to spread the smashed bananas into an even layer (they should be about 1/4-inch thick). This will be the base of your "bark."

Place peanut butter in a microwave safe dish, place in the microwave, and heat on high until pourable, about 30 seconds. Stir, then drizzle over the squished bananas and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the freezer and chill until the bark is set, about 1 hour.
When the bark is set, roughly chop peanuts.

Place chocolate chips in a clean microwave safe bowl. Heat in 30 second increments, stirring after each, until melted. Drizzle over the peanut butter layer and spread out evenly. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts, then return to the freezer and chill until the bark is solid, 8 hours or overnight.
Remove bark from the freezer, cut into portions, and enjoy! (Refreeze uneaten portions immediately.)
